meta.display: HIDDEN vocabulary: use it to find results, never render the phrases as hashtags, chips or tags.
meta.normalization: Fold both the query and the phrases before comparing: lowercase, c/c/s/z for c-caron/c-acute/s-caron/z-caron, "dj" for d-stroke, drop combining marks. Every phrase is already stored with and without diacritics; phraseIndex is keyed by the folded form.
